purpose.audience: Fictional readers evaluating a curated list
purpose.task: Inspect available reading entries and open one source
purpose.success: The reader understands the list status and opens an intended source

content.source: A reviewed local JSON file in the fictional product
content.freshness: The build displays the content review date and owner
content.fallback: Show an honest unavailable state without inventing entries

data.authority: The server-rendered reviewed content file is canonical

responsive: At narrow widths metadata moves below the title without changing reading order
Cards become a single list; text reflows at 400 percent zoom without horizontal scrolling
accessibility: The page uses one h1, a labelled list, descriptive links, and visible keyboard focus
Status changes use a polite live region and motion respects reduced-motion preference

performance.lcp_candidate: The page heading and first text entry; no hero image is required
budgets: No client JavaScript required for initial reading
No third-party request on initial load

security: Content is schema-validated and output-encoded before rendering
External URLs use an allow-listed https scheme and safe new-tab behavior when applicable

analytics.decision_question: Fictional example only: can a reader reach an intended source?
analytics.retention: Thirty days in the fictional example; not approved for real use

acceptance: Empty, offline, error, success, denied, and rate-limited states have deterministic fixtures
Keyboard, screen-reader, 320px, landscape, long-title, and 400 percent zoom checks pass
No request reaches a production service or real analytics endpoint
